description.value: Nancy Greene's Cahilty Lodge is a 168-room ski-resort hotel in the heart of Sun Peaks village, managed by Bear Country Property Management and named after Olympic skiing legend Nancy Greene. The property offers a range of unit types from standard hotel rooms to 3-bedroom suites, with ski-in/ski-out access directly onto the runs in winter. Its central village location puts guests steps from dining, shopping, and spa amenities, making it a convenient base for both winter and summer mountain activities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at cahiltyhotel.com confirms the lodge is actively taking bookings, corroborates the OSM phone number (250-578-6969) and address (3220 Village Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0). No mention of bike storage, laundry, drying areas, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the scraped website content, so those fields are null. Notably, OSM spells the lodge 'Cahility' while the website consistently spells it 'Cahilty' — this name discrepancy is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name spells lodge 'Cahility' but website consistently uses 'Cahilty' — possible OSM data entry error. Website spelling appears correct.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in Sun Peaks village with active booking system and confirmed contact details. Suitable for inclusion as accommodation for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: named after Olympic skiing legend Nancy Greene… ski-in/ski-out access directly onto the runs
